content: 1. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of nebivolol by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 2. Nefazodone increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 3. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both nelfinavir and tipranavir increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 4. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of netupitant/palonosetron by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Netupitant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, and no dosage adjustment is required. 5. Nevirapine decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both nevirapine and tipranavir increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 6. Tipranavir may alter nicardipine levels due to contradictory effects on hepatic CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 7. Nifedipine increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism, and tipranavir reciprocally increases nifedipine levels. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 8. Nilotinib increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 9. Tipranavir increases nimodipine levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 10. Nirmatrelvir increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Patients on ritonaviror cobicistat-containing HIV regimens should continue treatment as indicated. Monitor for increased adverse events related to nirmatrelvir/ritonavir or protease inhibitors. 11. Tipranavir increases nisoldipine levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 12. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of nortriptyline by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 13. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of oliceridine by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy modification may be required, including less frequent oliceridine dosing. Monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. 14. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of oliceridine by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification may be required, including less frequent oliceridine dosing. Monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. 15. Orlistat decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Loss of virological control has been reported in HIV-infected patients taking orlistat concomitantly. Monitor HIV RNA levels frequently, and if increased viral load is confirmed, discontinue orlistat. 16. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of osilodrostat by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; reduce the osilodrostat dose by half when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 17. Tipranavir increases ospemifene levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 18. Oxcarbazepine decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 19. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of oxycodone by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 20. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of oxymorphone by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 21. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 22. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel protein-bound by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 23. Tipranavir increases panobinostat levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; reduce the panobinostat starting dose to 10 mg when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 24. Tipranavir increases paricalcitol levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity. 25. Tipranavir and pentamidine both increase the risk of QTc interval prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 26. Pentobarbital decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 27. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of perampanel by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 28. Tipranavir enhances the effects of phenindione through pharmacodynamic synergy. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tipranavir has mild antiplatelet activity, which may increase bleeding risk. 29. Phenobarbital decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 30. Phenytoin decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 31. Tipranavir's effect on oral hypoglycemics like pioglitazone via hepatic CYP2C9 is unknown. Carefully monitor blood glucose levels. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 32. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of pitolisant by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; reduce the pitolisant dose by half when initiating strong CYP2D6 inhibitors. 33. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of polatuzumab vedotin by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Polatuzumab undergoes catabolism to small peptides, amino acids, and unconjugated MMAE-related catabolites. MMAE is a CYP3A4 substrate, and coadministration with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase MMAE AUC, potentially increasing polatuzumab vedotin toxicities. 34. Posaconazole increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 35. Tipranavir decreases the effects of pramlintide. Reports of hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance with protease inhibitors exist. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 36. Prednisone decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 37. Primidone decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 38. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of progesterone intravaginal gel by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 39. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of micronized progesterone by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 40. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of natural progesterone by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 41. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of propafenone by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 42. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of propranolol by inhibiting hepatic enzyme CYP2D6 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 43. Tipranavir enhances the effects of protamine through pharmacodynamic synergy. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Tipranavir has mild antiplatelet activity, which may increase bleeding risk. 44. Tipranavir decreases the levels or effects of quetiapine by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; monitor clinical response and potential adverse events more frequently. 45. Quinupristin/dalfopristin increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 46. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of repaglinide by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 47. Rifapentine decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 48. Tipranavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. Rilpivirine is not expected to affect the plasma concentrations of co-administered protease inhibitors. 49. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of riociguat by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 50. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of ripretinib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration with a strong CYP3A inhibitor increases systemic exposure to ripretinib and its active metabolite (DP-5439), potentially increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 51. Ritonavir increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both ritonavir and tipranavir increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 52. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of rivaroxaban by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 53. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of roflumilast by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 54. Tipranavir decreases the levels or effects of romidepsin via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. However, it also increases romidepsin levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 55. Tipranavir decreases the effects of rosiglitazone. Reports of hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance with protease inhibitors exist. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 56. Tipranavir increases rosuvastatin levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; do not exceed a rosuvastatin dose of 10 mg/day due to increased risk of myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis. 57. Rucaparib increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; adjust the dosage of CYP3A4 substrates if clinically indicated. 58. Rufinamide decreases the levels or effects of tipranavir by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 59. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of saxagliptin by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; limit saxagliptin to 5 mg/day when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 60. Tipranavir increases seladelpar levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely, especially in patients who are poor CYP2C9 metabolizers and are coadministered a moderate/strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 61. Tipranavir increases sildenafil levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely due to the potential for increased toxicity, including priapism, hypotension, and other adverse effects. 62. Tipranavir increases silodosin levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; use alternatives if available due to the potential for increased toxicity. 63. Tipranavir may alter sirolimus levels due to contradictory effects on hepatic CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 64. Tipranavir decreases the effects of sitagliptin. Reports of hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance with protease inhibitors exist. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 65. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of sorafenib by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 66. Stiripentol is both a CYP3A4 inhibitor and inducer. Tipranavir increases stiripentol levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; monitor CYP3A4 substrates coadministered with stiripentol for increased or decreased effects. 67. Tipranavir increases sufentanil levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 68. Tipranavir increases sufentanil SL levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration with any CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase sufentanil plasma concentration, potentially leading to prolonged adverse effects, including fatal respiratory depression. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 69. Tipranavir increases sunitinib levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification is required; use alternatives if available due to the potential for increased toxicity, including QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias. 70. Tipranavir may alter tacrolimus levels due to contradictory effects on hepatic CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Exercise caution and monitor closely. 71. Tipranavir increases tadalafil levels by inhibiting hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Exercise caution and monitor closely.
